subject: SOC 2 / SIG: Request for encryption key evidence & sampling plan
messages:
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@aurorafin.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: AuroraFin Compliance <compliance@aurorafin.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / SIG: encryption evidence request (KMS/HSM, rotation, transit)

Mina,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. AuroraFin's compliance team is starting a scoped SIG/SOC2 review of encryption and key management; we're collecting evidence for the encryption sub-control set over the next two weeks. Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following artifacts by 2028-06-12?

- HSM operator shift logs (sample): last 30 days, redacted operator IDs acceptable
- KMS rotation history: signing/KEK rotation events + who triggered them (audit trail CSV)
- Envelope-wrapping/transit proofs: cross-region handshake traces for inter-region replication
- Key custody & custody matrix: roles, separation of duties, emergency rewrap procedure
- Short writeup (1 page) describing your rotation cadence and rollback process for customer BYOK keys

Attached: SIG_questionnaire_v3.pdf (we filled a few fields; remaining tabs are 'evidence needed'). If you need to stage delivery (e.g., partial first pass), we can accept an initial package by 2028-06-06 and the remainder by the 12th.

Also please indicate the preferred secure exchange method (SFTP / secure drive link / enterprise ShareFile). We're flexible but need transfer with audit logging.

Appreciate it — Alicia
--
Alicia Park
Senior Compliance Manager, AuroraFin
alicia.park@aurorafin.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@aurorafin.com>
Cc: AuroraFin Compliance <compliance@aurorafin.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / SIG: encryption evidence request (KMS/HSM, rotation, transit)

Alicia — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a staged package. High level plan: 

1) By 2028-06-06: initial deliverables 
   - KMS rotation history (CSV export)
   - 1-page rotation cadence & rollback writeup
   - proposed secure transfer link (scoped Drive share + SFTP option)

2) By 2028-06-12: complete evidence package 
   - HSM shift log sample (redacted)
   - Operator custody matrix (signed)
   - Cross-region handshake traces (anonymized)

Irene and Jonas — looped you both for evidence pulls and to confirm redaction/retention windows. Irene, can you run the HSM shift log sampling routine (last 30 days) and place a tarball on the internal secure bucket? Jonas, can you help validate the CSV columns for rotation history (we prefer include event_id, timestamp, actor, action, affected_key_id, wrap_method) and approve the export format?

Preferred transfer: secure Drive link for initial review (we'll enable enterprise audit logging) and SFTP for the full package. We'll include checksums for every archive.

I'll post the Drive link and a short intake manifest shortly.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 / SIG: encryption evidence request (KMS/HSM, rotation, transit)

Folks — forwarding AuroraFin's ask and my reply. Quick tasking: 

- Irene: pull HSM operator shift logs (30-day window). Redact operator email addresses, keep operator IDs as anonymized hashes (we need to show separation of duties without PII). Package should include a digest.txt with SHA256 checksums. Target to stage on internal secure bucket by 2028-06-05 18:00 PT.

- Jonas: prepare the KMS rotation CSV export and include a brief schema doc. Prioritize event granularity (include pre/post wrap status). I expect we'll include a sampling of ephemeral KEK handovers for cross-region replication — please mark any RMK/wrap keys that are customer BYOK variants. Also confirm we can produce a short readme that explains the CSV columns.

I anticipate minimal legal redlines; we'll avoid including full operator names. If Aurora needs signed attestation for HSM vendor (attestation cert), let me know and I'll loop in legal.

I'll coordinate the Drive share and make sure we sign the manifest.

Mina

Alicia — attaching the initial evidence bundle for AuroraFin's review. We staged everything to a scoped Drive folder with audit logging enabled and provided an SFTP endpoint for the full transfer. Below is a short manifest of what we delivered now; the remaining items (if any) will follow in a secure SFTP push tomorrow morning.

Delivered (Drive link + SFTP will be sent in a separate secure email):
- kms-rotation-sample-plan.csv (CSV export: event_id,timestamp,actor,action,affected_key_id,wrap_method)
- hsm-operator-matrix.pdf (roles & separation of duties)
- hsm-shiftlog-sample.tar.gz (redacted logs; operator IDs hashed; digest.txt included)
- rotation-cadence-rollback.pdf (1-page summary of cadence and rollback steps)
- checksums.txt (SHA256 list for every file)

Notes: 
- Cross-region handshake traces were anonymized to remove customer payloads; we retained trace IDs and timestamps. If you need deeper packet-level artifacts, we'll require a scoped NDA amendment (network-level traces can contain customer metadata).
- BYOK keys are marked in the CSV with the flag customer_byo_k=true; we did not include key material.

Next steps: please acknowledge receipt and advise if you prefer us to upload the files to your SFTP endpoint. Also let us know if Aurora needs an HSM vendor attestation cert — we can request a fresh attestation from the provider, but that will take 3–5 business days.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
